submission.justification: After comprehensive simulation studies, Absorber-F3 with 5.3mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.075% at 100 GeV. This represents a significant improvement over Absorber-F1 (best: 3.733% at 4mm) and Absorber-F2 (best: 4.971% at 6mm). The optimization study around the initial 2025 baseline (5mm) confirmed that 5.3mm is near-optimal for F3, with resolution improving from 3.206% at 5mm to 3.075% at 5.3mm. This configuration meets all constraints: F3 is a listed candidate material, 5.3mm is within the 2-10mm plate thickness range, all materials are compatible with the mechanical support design, and no activation concerns were identified that would prevent hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Systematic scan of all three absorber materials across multiple plate thicknesses found that Absorber-F3 at 5.3mm delivers 3.075% resolution, the best performance observed. This outperforms F1 (best: 3.733% at 4mm) and F2 (best: 4.971% at 6mm).
